issues.issue: Is mens rea (knowledge or intent) required for a misrepresentation finding under IRPA 40(1)?
issues.applicant_position: Mens rea is required; she honestly believed the Adapana job was not necessary to disclose.
issues.respondent_position: No intent needed; she knew of the Adapana job and the form required full history, so no honest, reasonable belief.
issues.result_quote: intention of the applicant is not required for this provision to apply

issues.issue: Was the undisclosed Adapana employment a material fact?
issues.applicant_position: The Adapana job was not material: her listed experience already earned maximum points, and she disclosed once it mattered.
issues.respondent_position: Any failure to supply a truthful, complete application is material because it prevents full assessment of the applicant.
issues.result_quote: a failure (innocent or otherwise) to supply a “truthful, complete and correct” application is material

issues.issue: Should the two proposed questions be certified for appeal?
issues.applicant_position: Certify whether mens rea is required under s. 40(1) and whether a self-serving purpose is required.
issues.respondent_position: Not certifiable: question 1 is not determinative because s. 127 is not engaged; question 2 is settled law.
issues.result_quote: The second question is also not certifiable because the law is well established
